latestVersion.changelog:
Movie Maker Chromebook Free — Initial Release

- Launches the Movie Maker tool for easy Chromebook video editing using a cloud backend.
- Supports MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI file formats up to 500MB; renders 1080p MP4 exports in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic cloud session and token setup; users receive 100 free credits, no install required.
- Upload, trim, combine clips, add transitions, and export movies directly from Chromebook.
- Clear workflow and API details included for seamless video editing and export experience.
